description: The goldenratio.app Golden Calculator. Stack spacers numbered 1-11 (each is the previous x 1.618) on a left and a right side; returns whether both sides are equal and, if not, every combination of spacers that would make the shorter side match ("Try" on the site). The site starts with left = [6, 5, 6], right = [].

left.description: Spacer numbers stacked on the left, top to bottom, e.g. [6, 5, 6].

right.description: Spacer numbers stacked on the right.

name: golden_calculator
